title.en: An Act to Amend Section Two of Act Numbered thirty-One Hundred and Nineteen, Authorizing the Director of Agriculture to Purchase Motorcycles for the Anthrax

text.en:
Section two of Act Numbered Thirty-one hundred and nineteen is hereby amended to read as
"Section 2. The sum above appropriated shall be disbursed by the Director of Agriculture, with the approval
of the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources, for the purchase or manufacture of anthrax serum and
vaccine, the purchase of necessary instruments and utensils, the purchase of not more than ten fully equipped
motorcycles, the payment of salaries and traveling expenses of the necessary additional personnel, and the
payment of the necessary expenses of emergency guards for the proper enforcement of such quarantine
measures as may be prescribed and adopted."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 27, 1924.
